facts.summary: Phase 3 pancreatic trial missed overall survival endpoint; AML Phase 3 stopped for futility · Phase 3 · devimistat in metastatic pancreatic cancer and relapsed/refractory AML · not yet approved
facts.indication: metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma; relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia

evidence.summary: the AVENGER 500 Phase 3 clinical trial for CPI-613® (devimistat), Rafael Pharmaceuticals’ lead product candidate, did not meet its primary endpoint of significant improvement in overall survival
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Devimistat given with mFFX did not significantly improve overall survival (HR=0.95, p=0.66) compared to FFX alone.
